程序包 org.bukkit.block

接口 Sign

所有超级接口:
BlockState, Colorable, Metadatable, PersistentDataHolder, PersistentDataViewHolder, TileState
所有已知子接口:
HangingSign
public interface Sign extends TileState, Colorable
代表告示牌或者墙上告示牌.

原文： Represents a captured state of either a SignPost or a WallSign.

      @NotNull @Deprecated java.util.List<net.kyori.adventure.text.Component> lines()
      已过时。
      A sign may have multiple writable sides now. Use getSide(Side) and SignSide.lines().
      Gets all the lines of text currently on the Side.FRONT of this sign.
      返回:
      List of components containing each line of text

    • line

      @NotNull @Deprecated net.kyori.adventure.text.Component line(int index) throws java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException
      已过时。
      A sign may have multiple writable sides now. Use getSide(Side) and SignSide.line(int).
      Gets the line of text at the specified index on the Side.FRONT.

      For example, getLine(0) will return the first line of text.

      参数:
      index - Line number to get the text from, starting at 0
      返回:
      Text on the given line
      抛出:
      java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException - Thrown when the line does not exist

    • line

      @Deprecated void line(int index, @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component line) throws java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException
      已过时。
      A sign may have multiple writable sides now. Use getSide(Side) and SignSide.line(int, net.kyori.adventure.text.Component).
      Sets the line of text at the specified index on the Side.FRONT.

      For example, setLine(0, "Line One") will set the first line of text to "Line One".

      参数:
      index - Line number to set the text at, starting from 0
      line - New text to set at the specified index
      抛出:
      java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException - If the index is out of the range 0..3

    • getLine

      @Deprecated(since="1.20") @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String getLine(int index) throws java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException
      已过时。
      告示牌现在多面可写. 请使用 getSide(Side) 和 SignSide.getLines().

      原文：A sign may have multiple writable sides now. Use getSide(Side) and SignSide.line(int).

      获取指定行的文本.

      例如, getLine(0)将返回告示牌前面板第一行的文本.

      原文： Gets the line of text at the specified index.

      For example, getLine(0) will return the first line of text on the Side.FRONT.

      参数:
      index - 要获取的文本的行数,从0开始

      原文：Line number to get the text from, starting at 0

      返回:
      这个行的文本

      原文：Text on the given line

      抛出:
      java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException - 当此行不存在(尚未设置)时抛出

      原文：Thrown when the line does not exist

    • setLine

      @Deprecated(since="1.20") void setLine(int index, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String line) throws java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException
      已过时。
      告示牌现在多面可写. 请使用 getSide(Side) 和 SignSide.getLines().

      原文：A sign may have multiple writable sides now. Use getSide(Side) and SignSide.line(int, net.kyori.adventure.text.Component).

      设置指定索引行的文本.

      例如,setLine(0, "行1") 将设置告示牌第一行的文本为"行1".

      请注意:从0开始数行.

      原文： Sets the line of text at the specified index.

      For example, setLine(0, "Line One") will set the first line of text to "Line One".

      参数:
      index - 要设置的文本的行数,从0开始

      原文：Line number to set the text at, starting from 0

      line - 新的指定的文本索引

      原文：New text to set at the specified index

      抛出:
      java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException - 如果索引超出了0-3的范围

      原文：If the index is out of the range 0..3

    • isWaxed

      boolean isWaxed()
      获取此告示牌是否已被涂蜡. 如果告示牌已被涂蜡, 则玩家无法编辑.

      原文： Gets whether or not this sign has been waxed. If a sign has been waxed, it cannot be edited by a player.

      返回:
      此告示牌是否已被涂蜡

      原文：if this sign is waxed

    • getAllowedEditor

      @Nullable @Nullable Player getAllowedEditor()
      获取当前被允许编辑此告示牌的玩家.
      如果此值不为 null, 则其他玩家的编辑将被拒绝.

      原文： Gets the player that is currently allowed to edit this sign.
      Edits from other players will be rejected if this value is not null.

      You should prefer getAllowedEditorUniqueId() if you don't need the player instance as this method will fetch the player from UUID.

      返回:
      被允许编辑此告示牌的玩家, 或 null

      原文：the player allowed to edit this sign, or null

    • getAllowedEditorUniqueId

      @Nullable java.util.UUID getAllowedEditorUniqueId()
      Gets the allowed editor's UUID.
      Edits from other players will be rejected if this value is not null.
      返回:
      the allowed editor's UUID, or null

    • setAllowedEditorUniqueId

      void setAllowedEditorUniqueId(@Nullable java.util.UUID uuid)
      Sets the allowed editor's UUID.

      Note: the server sets the UUID back to null if the player can't interact with the sign (is either offline or outside the allowed interaction range).
      参数:
      uuid - the allowed editor's UUID
